maria_f: FYI invoice INV-8923 for NovaHealth (acct: NOVA-77) failed to auto-charge at 03:12 UTC. Decline returned as `do_not_honor` and provider metadata shows 3DS challenge required. Customer says they updated card yesterday. Can payments + ops triage?

payments-bot: Automated event: payment.failed - invoice=INV-8923 amount=3,450 USD provider=stripe code=do_not_honor

sam_payments: Looking at Stripe: charge attempt `ch_3Kq...` -> status: failed. Auth result field: `authentication_required`. Country on card: NG, last4 3456. Provider note: issuer attempted challenge but returned `challenge_failed`. Log snippet:```
provider: stripe
charge_id: ch_3Kqxyz
status: failed
decline_code: do_not_honor
auth_result: authentication_required
issuer_response: challenge_failed
last4: 3456
country: NG
```

oliver_cs: Customer ticket #12456 — they attached a screenshot of the bank 3DS modal that said "Verification failed" after entering OTP. They tried twice. Customer asked if we can charge a backup card or provide a link.

maria_f: We can't force through 3DS. Options: 1) Ask customer to try a different card (preferred), 2) Send a hosted payment link so they can re-enter card and complete 3DS, 3) Offer one-time wire (manual) as fallback for this invoice. For NG cards ACH isn't an option. Need approval for wire fallback from ops/finance because amount > $3k.

jean_ops: I can approve one-time wire for this customer if legal signs off on a simple invoice acceptance clause. Amount 3,450 USD — this is within our discretionary review. CC legal (@legal). Also note: wires to international banks add ~2 business days.

sam_payments: I'll generate a hosted payment link (Stripe Checkout) that forces re-auth and 3DS. Template link below (expires 24h). We should include `payment_method_types=card` and `setup_future_usage=off_session` to avoid unintended saves. Example command:```bash
# create checkout session (example)
curl -X POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions 
  -u sk_live_xxx: 
  -d payment_method_types[]=card 
  -d mode=payment 
  -d line_items[0][price_data][currency]=usd 
  -d line_items[0][price_data][product_data][name]="INV-8923" 
  -d line_items[0][price_data][unit_amount]=345000 
  -d success_url="https://redwood.example/success" 
  -d cancel_url="https://redwood.example/cancel"
```
I'll paste the generated URL once created.

oliver_cs: Please also give me a short customer-facing note I can send that explains 3DS and next steps. Keep it short, <3 bullet points.

maria_f: Draft for support message:```
Hi NovaHealth team —

Thanks for the heads up. Our payment attempt was declined because the issuing bank requires 3D Secure (an additional card verification step). Please try one of the options below:

• Click this secure payment link and re-enter your card to complete bank verification (link expires in 24h).
• Use an alternative card if available.
• If you prefer, reply and we can provide wire instructions — note wires take 1–3 business days.

If you want the wire option, please confirm and we’ll share bank details and an invoice copy.

Thanks — Maria, Billing Ops
```

sam_payments: Session created. Public link: https://pay.redwood.example/checkout/s/abc123 (expires in 24h). I've also set `payment_intent[metadata][invoice]=INV-8923` and `payment_intent[description]=NovaHealth invoice 8923`.

oliver_cs: Sent to customer with Maria's copy + link. Customer replied: "Thanks — trying link now." :crossed_fingers:

payments-bot: Automated event: payment.succeeded - invoice=INV-8923 amount=3450 USD provider=stripe charge=ch_3Kq_success

maria_f: Success! Payment went through via the hosted link; 3DS completed. Marking invoice as paid and updating the account. Leaving wire option on table if they need receipts for reconciliation. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
